basic_details.job_title: IIT Gandhinagar Project Associate I Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: The Department of Electrical Engineering at IIT Gandhinagar has invited applications for 2 temporary Project Associate - I positions on the project "NSF-MeitY: Fundamental Realizable Limit Vibration Energy Harvesting: Design, Analysis, and Implementation". Pay is ₹37,000 + HRA for scholars selected through NET or GATE or a national level examination, and ₹30,000 + HRA for others. The appointment is for 1 year or until project completion on 10.12.2027, whichever is earlier. Applications are made through the institute's online link by 3 December 2026.

qualification.details: MTech/ME or BTech/BE in Electronics/Electrical or Equivalent Engineering Stream with either of the following profiles: | Knowledge of schematic design, PCB layout, component selection, and prototyping; experience in embedded systems, microcontrollers, and firmware development using C/C++ and Python; familiarity with sensors, ADC, UART, SPI, and I²C interfaces; hands-on experience with oscilloscopes, digital multi-meter, function generators, bench power supplies, etc.; skills in hardware debugging, circuit testing, soldering, and prototype validation. OR proficiency with analog and mixed-signal IC design; experience with circuit simulation tools like Cadence Virtuoso or equivalent EDA tools; familiarity with open-source circuit design and simulation tools is required. | Experience of building AI tools and experience with IC layout are added advantages. Candidates should check the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of the post.

how_to_apply: Applications are submitted through the application link given in the notice, http://recruitment.iitgn.ac.in/projectstaff/, on or before 3 December 2026. The notice does not describe the form-filling steps or name any documents to upload. The contact named in the notice is Madhav K Pathak, [email protected].
important_instructions: Merely meeting the minimum eligibility criteria will not guarantee shortlisting and/or appointment. A higher cutoff level may be used. The Institute reserves all rights not to call an applicant for a selection test, or not to fill up a position through this round of selection process, without assigning any reason. The position is temporary, for 1 Year or project completion 10.12.2027, whichever is earlier.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: The notice ticks "Funding Agency norms" for eligibility; "Institute norms" is not ticked. The essential qualification is one of the following, from a recognized University or equivalent: Four years Bachelor's Degree in Natural or Agricultural Sciences Master's Degree in Natural or Agricultural Sciences BVSc B.Pharm Bachelor's degree in Engineering or Technology or Medicine The minimum marks are 60% or equivalent grade from graduation onwards, and 55% or equivalent grade in class 10th and 12th. MTech/ME or BTech/BE in Electronics/Electrical or Equivalent Engineering Stream with either of the following profiles: Knowledge of schematic design, PCB layout, component selection, and prototyping; experience in embedded systems, microcontrollers, and firmware development using C/C++ and Python; familiarity with sensors, ADC, UART, SPI, and I²C interfaces; hands-on experience with oscilloscopes, digital multi-meter, function generators, bench power supplies, etc.; skills in hardware debugging, circuit testing, soldering, and prototype validation. OR proficiency with analog and mixed-signal IC design; experience with circuit simulation tools like Cadence Virtuoso or equivalent EDA tools; familiarity with open-source circuit design and simulation tools is required. Experience of building AI tools and experience with IC layout are added advantages. Candidates should check the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of the post.

rows.category_of_scholar: (i) Selected through National Eligibility Tests (CSIR-UGC including Lectureship (Assistant Professorship)) or GATE, or through a selection process via national level examinations conducted by Central Government Departments and their Agencies and Institutions
(ii) Others who do not fall under (i) above

content_sections.heading: IIT Gandhinagar Project Associate - I Job Description
content_sections.text: The notice gives two alternative role descriptions: Embedded systems development, circuit design, PCB layout, and hardware prototyping. Responsibilities include firmware development, sensor interfacing, hardware testing and debugging, soldering using laboratory instruments, and prototype validation, on-site testing for ongoing R&D projects. OR exploring open-source tools for analog and mixed-signal circuit design, simulation, and layout for low-power IC design, with integration of AI for analog IC design automation to be explored further.

The notice does not describe the form-filling steps or name any documents to upload. The contact named in the notice is Madhav K Pathak, [email protected] .
